steps.title: Pre-create SupervisorNamespace ({{app}}-dev-{{project}})
steps.purpose: Create the namespace via kubectl with generateName so the supervisor admission webhook accepts it (G-020). Use the large class for the storage budget the VKS + app PVCs need.

results.text: deploy gate: could not locate SupervisorNamespace '{{namespace}}' under any project via context '{{kube-context}}', skipping pre-flight (proceeding). Set PCA_PROJECT to override.

steps.title: Submit {{app}}-db-01 Service out-of-band (G-053 Workaround B)
steps.purpose: kubectl-apply the ClusterIP VirtualMachineService directly into the namespace. vRA never tracks it and so cannot hang on its success-criteria handler. VKS pods will resolve {{app}}-db-01.<ns>.svc.cluster.local once postgres VM gets its primaryIP4.

steps.title: Submit vRA catalog deploy
steps.purpose: Hand the published hybrid-3tier-tiny blueprint to vRA. vRA orchestrates: DB VM bootstrap secret → DB VM → DB service → VKS Cluster CR (CAPI v1beta2 per G-023).

steps.title: Wait for VKS Cluster: Provisioned + control plane Ready (the slow step, ~20-30 min)
steps.purpose: VKS provisioning brings up the control plane VM, configures Kubernetes, joins the worker VMs, installs Antrea CNI.
steps.file: (VKS Service in the supervisor reconciles the Cluster CR)

results.text: Waiting up to 1800s for VKS cluster '{{app}}-dev-vks' to reach Provisioned + control plane Available...

steps.title: Fetch VKS kubeconfig (D-023 canonical: vcf cluster kubeconfig get)
steps.purpose: Retrieve the VKS guest cluster's cert-based kubeconfig, years-long lifetime, GitOps-friendly.

results.text: fetch_vks_kubeconfig: pulled from per-namespace API (5670 bytes)

steps.title: Apply app + web tier manifests INTO the VKS guest cluster
steps.purpose: The blueprint provisioned only Supervisor-layer resources (DB VM + VKS CR). Now apply the in-VKS workloads (namespace + ConfigMap + Deployments + LoadBalancer Service).

results.text: pca-supervisor-api-creds Secret applied (init container will use it for DB discovery)
App + web tier applied to VKS

steps.title: Post-deploy verification + audience-facing URL
steps.purpose: Wait for app + web pods to be Ready; surface the LoadBalancer external IP.

results.text: Verifying database VM is powered on...
Waiting up to 120s for app + web tier Pods to be Ready...
Some pods not Ready, check 'kubectl get pods -n {{app}}'

steps.title: Persist state for sibling demo phases + capture lab/state actualization (D-022)
steps.purpose: Save deployment_id + namespace + identity + env so 02-day2-tour.sh / 03-cleanup.sh auto-discover. Capture lab/state/<bundle>/<env>/namespace.yaml so ArgoCD's root ApplicationSet picks up the actualized namespace.

results.text: git add lab/state/hybrid-3tier-tiny/dev/ && git commit -m 'lab(state): capture hybrid-3tier-tiny/dev {{namespace}}'
K8s ground-truth:   GREEN (VKS Provisioned + app/web Ready, authoritative)
G-055: vRA marks the deployment CREATE_FAILED at the 2-hour internal
timeout because the VksCluster resource never reaches state=OK in
vRA's snapshot, even though K8s shows phase=Provisioned with all
critical conditions True. This is a vRA-side defect; the deployed

steps.title: Delete vRA deployment record (force-delete)
steps.purpose: Tell vRA to release tracking on this deployment with forceDelete=true so vRA bypasses its child-resource readiness checks. Without force, vRA's per-resource cascade-delete races kubectl's namespace teardown in step 2 and typically loses, producing a DELETE_FAILED record with 'Supervisor namespace is not ready'. With force, vRA records the delete cleanly regardless of namespace state (G-038).

steps.title: Delete SupervisorNamespace + poll for full termination
steps.purpose: Cascade-deletes everything: DB VM (+ snapshots), VKS Cluster (+ control plane VM + worker VMs + all in-VKS workloads). VKS teardown is the long pole (~10-20 min).

steps.title: Remove lab/state actualization (D-022)
steps.purpose: Delete lab/state/hybrid-3tier-tiny/dev/. ArgoCD's root ApplicationSet deregisters the corresponding Application on next sync.

results.text: git add lab/state/ && git commit -m 'lab(state): remove hybrid-3tier-tiny/dev'
